title: annotatr-control-v1 command envelope
description: Every POST body. Unknown optional data belongs under 'extensions'; any other top-level property is rejected. content_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of 'payload' (sorted keys, no whitespace).

payload.description: Operation-specific fields. session.load: images (paths relative to the root), labels, handoff, discard_unsaved (boolean; required to replace a session with unsaved or staged changes, otherwise UNSAVED_CHANGES). mask.preview: mask_type, overlap, level (default: the finest level within the preview pixel budget), max_dim, include_png. close is not checked against expected_revision.
